title: Family of Complex Solutions in Simple Harmonic Motion
full_prompt: Write a complete Manim scene named `ShowFamilyOfComplexSolutions` that visualizes a family of complex solutions to a differential equation representing a spring-mass system. The scene must include a spring-mass system simulation (using a custom `SrpingMassSystem` class or similar) and show how complex exponentials or complex solutions relate to the physical motion. Specifically, render a spring-mass system with adjustable parameters (like spring constant $k$, damping $\mu$), and display a family of complex solution curves (e.g., $e^{st}$ where $s$ is complex) on a complex plane or coordinate system, showing how different complex coefficients scale and rotate the solutions to form real physical trajectories.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect integration of the ODE in the spring-mass system updater leading to numerical instability or explosion.
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the time_step method uses a sufficiently small dt_size or sub-stepping to keep the simulation stable.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Mismatch between the physical spring-mass position and the complex plane trajectory visualization.
common_failure_modes.note: The real part of the complex solution must align perfectly with the horizontal or vertical displacement of the physical mass.
